# Families for Addiction Recovery (FAR Canada)

> > Families for Addiction Recovery (FAR) is a Canadian advocacy organization supporting families affected by substance use disorder through peer support, policy advocacy, and education.

FAR works with healthcare providers, government agencies like Health Canada and Ontario's Ministry of Health, and organizations such as the Canadian Society of Addiction Medicine (CSAM) to improve addiction treatment access, reduce stigma, and advocate for evidence-based policies including harm reduction and decriminalization. The organization provides resources for family caregivers and amplifies lived experience voices in addiction policy.

## Key Topics

- Substance use disorder (SUD)
- Family caregivers in addiction
- Harm reduction strategies
- Decriminalization of drug possession
- Youth addiction crisis
- Involuntary treatment policies
- Opioid overdose epidemic
- Recovery stories and lived experience
- Mental health and addiction intersection
- Ontario addiction services
- Policy advocacy and reform
- Canadian Society of Addiction Medicine (CSAM)
- Criminal justice system transformation
- Addiction treatment access
- Healthcare provider education

## Policy Advocacy & Government Submissions

- [Request for Urgent Action Regarding Youth Addiction](https://www.farcanada.org/news/request-for-urgent-action-regarding-youth-addiction): FAR urges Federal & Ontario Health Ministers on youth addiction crisis
- [Policy Brief: CSAM in Support of the Decriminalization of Drug Use and Possession for Personal Use](https://www.farcanada.org/news/policy-brief-csam-support-decriminalization-drug-use-possession-personal-use): CSAM policy brief advocating decriminalization of drug possession
- [Transformation of the Criminal Justice System](https://www.farcanada.org/news/transformation-criminal-justice-system): FAR submission to Dept of Justice on criminal justice reform & addiction
- [Submission on Bill 89, Supporting Children, Youth and Families Act, 2017](https://www.farcanada.org/news/1235): FAR submission to Standing Committee on Bill 89 youth treatment policy
- [Ontario Cannabis Secretariat Meeting Notes](https://www.farcanada.org/news/ontario-cannabis-secretariat-meeting-notes): FAR's notes from Ontario Cannabis Secretariat stakeholder meeting
